title: Pipe Work Characteristics
objective: Recognise key pipework characteristics that must be understood from controlled job information.

sections.heading: 1. Pipework context
sections.body: Pipework is defined by characteristics such as component type, dimensions, material and intended service requirements.

sections.heading: 2. Material and specification
sections.body: Material identity and specification information must correspond with the controlled design requirement.

sections.heading: 3. Connections and relationships
sections.body: Components form part of a system and must be understood in relation to drawings and specifications.

sections.heading: 4. Verify information
sections.body: Unclear identification or requirements must be referred for clarification.

questions.question: Can pipework characteristics include material and dimensions?
Are components understood in relation to the system?
